Castle Siege Solitaire
The castle walls await, Hero.
Breach every chamber and slay every enemy.

Choose Your Character:

Card Types:
♦ = Weapons
♥ = Health Potion
A♦ = Scabbard
A♥ = Potion Belt
♠ / ♣ = Enemies

How to Play:

Goal: Defeat the enemies in the castle using weapons and potions.

Castle is the remaining cards in the deck.

Chamber is the current room you are in. There are four cards to a chamber.

To leave a chamber you must action at least three cards in the chamber. You may action all four.

You may flee and draw a new chamber if you have not actioned any cards and you did not flee the previous chamber.

Drag and drop cards to action them.

An enemy may be defeated barehanded by dropping them in the discard pile. You take damage equal to the card's number value (J/Q/K/A are 11/12/13/14 respectively).

Alternatively, an enemy may be defeated using an equipped weapon by dropping them onto your equipped weapon. The damage you take is decreased by the number value of your weapon (zero damage if your weapon is greater).

A weapon can only fight an enemy equal or less in value than the previous enemy it defeated.

You may only use one potion per chamber. Use a potion by dropping it in the vitality square.

You may discard potions and weapons without using them.

Scabbard and Potion Belt each hold only one item.
